selection: Preregistered before any round-005 inference. Version 2 replaces the unrun version 1 after an external review: the primary test now targets the pass@10 difference, effort is the only confirmatory claim, and every prompt is new.
decision: Confirmatory claim (effort): the pooled one-sided score test of plain max minus medium no-evidence pass@10, averaged equally over Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6 Astra, has p <= 0.05.
Per-model effort results are secondary: each is claimed only if the pooled test passes and its Holm-adjusted one-sided score-test p is <= 0.05. Raw and Holm p are reported together.
The meta-prompt family is exploratory. Its estimates and both tests are reported with raw and Holm p, and no confirmatory claim is made from it.
The distribution test is reported for every pair as a secondary result. A rejection means the conditions behave differently, not that their scores differ.

Every planned job counts; invalid answers are misses. If the round does not complete with all 10 conditions, 48 cases and 20 runs per cell, every test is withheld. An aborted round is published as stopped; this specification is not reused for a rerun.
Conservative fixed-prompt bounds and scenario sensitivity are reported alongside, as for earlier rounds.
